data.content_ref: inline:The proposed discriminator is self-defeating under its own mechanism. It claims mere checklist-tracking yields independent, item-local errors, but any checklist whose under-specification is itself systematic (e.g., omits an entire cognitive primitive) produces exactly the correlated degradation by latent subtask structure that the test uses to identify 'genuine reliability.' Thus an incomplete-but-systematic checklist mimics the signature of competence, and the test cannot distinguish a genuine panel from a panel that merely complies with a systematically incomplete checklist.
